observations.claim: The affected invoice was assigned to domestic review and then returned for EU approval.

links.quote: Assigned to domestic queue by rule R7.
Domestic reviewer returned invoice: EU approval required.

hypotheses.explanation: Routing input or rule mapping lost the submitted region, causing a domestic fallback and a later handoff.

supporting.quote: Rule R7 read region as empty and selected domestic fallback.
Invoice submitted with supplier region EU.

hypotheses.discriminating_check: Read the R7 input mapping and contemporaneous routing payload for INV-104 within the remaining scope.
hypotheses.counterfactual: If the EU region reached the routing rule, the invoice might have reached international review first.

hypotheses.explanation: A supplier lookup outage forced fallback routing.

contradicting.quote: Supplier lookup completed successfully in 120 ms.

hypotheses.discriminating_check: Check bounded lookup error evidence; one sampled successful span does not rule out an outage.
hypotheses.counterfactual: Reliable lookup would prevent fallback only if missing lookup data drove the rule.

controls.proposal: Pilot a review queue for missing routing region instead of defaulting to domestic approval.
controls.measure: Collect a two-week baseline of region-related returns divided by all submitted invoices; compare with the two-week pilot and monitor approval lead time.
controls.review_window: Two weeks baseline plus two weeks pilot
controls.tradeoff: May add manual review work and delay valid domestic invoices.

unknowns: R7 input mapping and policy intent are not provided.
Queue capacity and complete lookup coverage are unavailable.
Two selected invoices cannot establish recurrence prevalence or causal effect.
